json.overall_experience: This CEO likely found Smartsheet to be a significant upgrade from Excel, appreciating its ability to centralize project workflows and improve team collaboration. The familiar spreadsheet interface eased adoption, while the enhanced project management tools provided much-needed visibility and control. While generally satisfied, they may have encountered some frustrations with the complexity of advanced features or the speed of the platform at times.
